<div class="card-body">
'''Hear Me Baby, Hold Together''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">頼むぞ、もちこたえてくれよ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手が宇宙船用兵器を自分の宇宙船に対して使った時に使う。相手の武器運命数は、どれも－２される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-85o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密輸屋や反乱軍は闇ルートで入手した装甲や防御シールドを使って戦火に備える。金はかかるが、命が助かれば安いものだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Come on, hold together.

'''Card text:''' Use when your opponent uses a starship weapon against your starship. Subtract 2 from each of your opponent's weapon destiny draws.

'''Lore:''' Smugglers and Rebels prepare for battle with armor and defensive shields obtained through underground channels. They cost money, but that is a small price if they save your life.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hear Me Baby, Hold Together]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
